reviews.title: Corsair Quality and Efficiency
reviews.comment: I almost bought the 5000 LX case series but ended buying this one because of stock. No complaints on price and boy is this case huge. Room for everything I had and space for cooling. The icue system is great but mind the wiring hub, too much things connected could lead to reduced brightness or power delivery of fans and devices. Everything was spot on on build quality and boy is it a visual glamour with RGBs thanks to the temper glass design. Cleverly positioned straps and plenty space for drives. The tunneling air effect is amazing with full 10 fans. You just can go wrong with Corsair!
reviews.author: Alex Figueroa
